caseName: Maloy v. First Federal Savings & Loan Ass'n of West Palm Beach
caseNameFull: Maloy et ux. v. First Federal Savings & Loan Association of West Palm Beach

opinions.text: The application for stay of the issuance of the order denying petition for writ of certiorari (ante, p. 824) referred to the Court by Mr. Justice Black is granted pending-the timely filing and disposition of a petition for rehearing.
